digest_of: Each digest is a BLAKE3 hash of the policy definition file (policy.toml) in the VertRule shared governance infrastructure. Policy source material is not bundled in this repository. The digest is the verifiable anchor; the overlay (if any) is bundled locally.

bindings.notes: Scope overlay restricts to src/**/*.rs; no allowlist exceptions
Tier boundary enforcement — no overlay needed
Float glovebox — no bare float arithmetic; f32::from_bits for finiteness checks is exempt
Lane B+C capability admission — declaration required for all edits under governed paths
